title: Supreme Court rejects Verizon bid for $47 million refund of FCC fine
summary: The carriers sold device-location information to data aggregators, who resold it to other firms. When a three-judge panel at the 2nd Circuit unanimously ruled against Verizon, it rejected Verizon’s Seventh Amendment claim and its claim that selling the location data was legal.
